div.head: VI Atr 42.1
div.ab: ⁊ þæt he fram synnan georne gecyrre ⁊ oþrum mannum unrihtes styre,
⁊ þæt he fram sinnum georne gecirre ⁊ oðrum mannum unrihtes stire ⁊ he þæt ofer ealle oðre þinge lufige his Drihten,
⁊ þæt he fram synnan georne gecyrre ⁊ oþrum mannum unrihtes styre,
And þæt he fram synnan georne gecyrre and oþrum mannum unrihtes styre.
und dass er von Sünden willig umkehre und anderen Leuten Unrecht verwehre (und dass er vor allen anderen Dingen seinen Herr[gott] liebe D)
and that he turn eagerly from sins and restrain other people from wrongdoing (and that he love his Lord above all other things, D)
and eagerly to turn from sins, and to restrain other men from wrong-doing,
And they are to readily turn from sin, and to curb the injustice caused by others.
div.note: D's ‘⁊ he þæt’ should be corrected to ‘þæt he’ (Liebermann).

note.seg: Der Gedanke kommt, auch in genau diesen Worten, so häufig bei damaligen Predigern vor, dass Benutzung von VI Atr 1 unsicher ist; s. Gl Gerechtigkeit 5. b
The idea occurs, even in exactly these words, so frequently in the preachers of the time that use of VI Atr 1 is uncertain; see Gl Gerechtigkeit 5. b
D's Zusatz auch in jener Homilie
D’s addition is also in that homily
In anderen Worten VIII Atr 43, 1 = I Cn 21; auch o. 1
In different words VIII Atr 43, 1 = I Cn 21; also above 1
